raw.details:
Innovate India – National Hackathon 2026

Innovate. Build. Inspire.

Join now Official WhatsApp Community for important updates hackathon rounds, submission deadlines, shortlisting results, prizes, certificates, and announcements.

Innovate India 2026 is a national-level online hackathon bringing together students, developers, and innovators to transform creative ideas into real-world solutions.

Showcase your skills, build impactful projects, and compete for exciting prizes, AI credits, goodies, and certificates!

Event Details

  • Dates: 3 NOV– 6 DEC 2026
  • Mode: Online
  • Team Size: 1 member
  • Eligibility: Students and tech enthusiasts
  • Registration: FREE

Hackathon Rounds

  • Round 1 — Idea Submission
    3 –17 November 2026
  • Submit a 6–8-slide PPT/PDF explaining your project idea, problem statement, proposed solution, technology stack, and impact.
  • No coding required!
  • Round 2 — Project Development
    18 – 28 November 2026
  • Shortlisted teams will build a working prototype of their proposed solution.
  • Round 3 — Grand Finale
    29 November 2026

Top teams will present their projects for final evaluation.

Prizes & Rewards

1st Place — Best Overall Project

  • ₹10000 cash worth AI credits
  • Winner Certificate
  • Exclusive DevHarbour Goodies
  • Feature Project On Official Web

2nd Place — First Runner-Up

  • Runner-Up Certificate
  • Feature project on official web
  • Participation Certificate 

3rd Place — Second Runner-Up

  • Runner-Up Certificate
  • Feature project on official web
  • Participation Certificate 

Special Recognition Awards

  • Best UI/UX Design
  • Best AI Innovation
  • Most Innovative Project
  • Best Technical Implementation
  • Best Real-World Impact
  • Rising Innovator Award

Certificates: Digital participation certificates for valid Round 1 submissions, finalist certificates, and special winner certificates.

Innovation Tracks

Participants can choose any of the following tracks based on their interests and project ideas:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies – Generative AI, Machine Learning, AI Agents, Chatbots, Computer Vision, NLP, Predictive Analytics, Automation, and Intelligent Systems.
  • Web & Mobile Development – Full-Stack Applications, Mobile Apps, SaaS Platforms, E-Commerce, Developer Tools, Productivity Applications, and Cloud-Based Solutions.
  • Cybersecurity & Digital Safety – Threat Detection, Network Security, Ethical Hacking Tools, Fraud Detection, Data Privacy, Digital Identity, and Secure Authentication.
  • Healthcare & Medical Technology – Health Monitoring, Telemedicine, AI-Assisted Healthcare, Medical Data Analysis, Accessibility Tools, and Digital Health Solutions.
  • Education & Learning Technology – AI Tutors, Personalized Learning Platforms, Virtual Classrooms, Coding Platforms, Skill Development Tools, and Gamified Learning.
  • FinTech & Blockchain – Digital Payments, Financial Literacy, Fraud Prevention, Smart Contracts, Decentralized Applications, and Blockchain-Based Solutions.
  • Sustainability & Green Technology – Climate Tech, Waste Management, Smart Agriculture, Renewable Energy, Water Conservation, and Environmental Monitoring.
  • Smart Cities & IoT – Smart Infrastructure, Traffic Management, IoT Automation, Smart Homes, Public Safety, and Connected Devices.
  • Social Impact & Accessibility – Assistive Technologies, Women’s Safety, Rural Development, Disaster Management, Community Solutions, and Inclusive Technology.
  • Open Innovation – Any unique, creative, and technology-driven project that addresses a real-world problem beyond the listed categories.

Note: Participants are free to use any programming language, framework, or technology stack. Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical feasibility, creativity, and real-world impact.

Rules

  • Individual and team participation allowed.
  • Original ideas and projects only.
  • Shortlisting is based on innovation, feasibility, and impact.
  • Participants must submit before the deadlines.
  • The judging panel's decisions will be final, subject to correction of scoring errors.

Why Participate?

Gain hands-on experience, build your portfolio, earn certificates, win rewards, and showcase your innovation to the DevHarbour community.

Great ideas deserve to be built!

Register for FREE and begin your innovation journey!

Powered by DevHarbour — One Universe. Endless Possibilities.
